page: Amazon Web Services g6.16xlarge is a GPU-accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. The platform combines 64 virtual central processing units derived from 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7R13 processor running at 3.4 GHz with 256 GB of DDR4 system memory running at 3 GHz. For hardware acceleration, it bundles a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPU equipped with 22 GB of video memory. Local high-speed storage is integrated as an 1880 GB NVMe solid-state drive, while networking capabilities feature a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps.

Benchmark results demonstrate significant compute capacity across parallelized and vector workloads. Multi-core performance metrics in stress-ng and Geekbench place the system in the top tier, reflected in tasks such as Clang software compilation and ray tracing. For machine learning tasks, the integrated NVIDIA L4 accelerator delivers top-decile token throughput for small and medium language model inference, achieving over 2270 tokens per second for prompt processing on 7B models. However, the 22 GB VRAM ceiling constrains larger parameter models, where 70B generation drops sharply to weak throughput percentiles due to offloading bottlenecks.

System memory and storage subsystems exhibit high throughput in cached and transactional database profiles, verified by 62.3 million Redis SET operations per second and strong PassMark database scores. In contrast, uncached sequential memory bandwidth benchmarks settle into the middle percentile range. The absence of AVX-512 instruction flags also shifts intensive vector operations toward the GPU rather than the host CPU.

The AWS g6.16xlarge instance delivers strong resource density by packaging a modern tensor-capable accelerator, substantial DDR4 capacity, and dedicated NVMe storage into a single host footprint. It is well matched for mid-tier AI inference pipelines, real-time video transcode, graphics rendering workloads, and high-throughput application backends requiring co-located local caching.
description: Amazon Web Services g6.16xlarge is an accelerated computing instance powered by a 32-core AMD EPYC 7R13 processor providing 64 vCPUs at 3.4 GHz, 256 GB of DDR4 system memory, and a single NVIDIA Ada Lovelace L4 GPU with 22 GB of VRAM. Built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor, the platform incorporates an 1880 GB NVMe SSD for fast local scratch space and maintains a 25 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmarks demonstrate top-tier execution across multi-core processing, software compilation, and small-to-medium large language model inference. While large 70B models exceed the single-GPU memory capacity, high throughput in Redis operations and transactional database benchmarks confirms the host system efficiency. The g6.16xlarge provides a balanced hardware distribution for mid-scale AI inference, real-time graphics rendering, video processing pipelines, and data-intensive compute workloads.
